rules: Face should take up 80-85% of the photograph (confirmed directly from mportal.passportindia.gov.in on 2026-09-13). SpecShot's 36-38mm head-height range above is derived from that percentage assuming a 45mm-tall frame — it is not an independently published mm figure, unlike UK/Canada/Australia where a chin-to-crown mm range is stated directly.

PRINT SIZE NOT DIRECTLY STATED: the source gives digital pixel dimensions (630x810px) and the 80-85% face rule, but no explicit mm print size. 35x45mm is the conventional size matching that exact pixel aspect ratio (630:810 = 35:45), not a number read from the source itself.
Full head, top of hair to bottom of chin, centred, not tilted; no head coverings except for religious reasons
Neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open and clearly visible, no red-eye or shadows
NOT PUBLISHED IN THE SOURCE READ: no eye-line position from the bottom of the photo is stated. The range below is a wide, non-rejecting placeholder, not a sourced target.
File size limit not found in the document checked this session — leave unconfirmed rather than import an unverified figure from a third-party site.
